rules: graph: rings n_l = max(4, floor(32 (L-l+1)/L + 1/2)); lateral ring edges weight gamma^(l-1); radial edges weight 1 by exact nearest-angle rule (ties lowest index) plus back-fill; centre joined to ring L with weight 1
energy: 1/2 u^T K u + sum V(u) + 1/2 lambda sum_ring1 (u - h)^2, lambda = 1; V linear mu u^2/2 or double well beta (u^2-1)^2/4, on every unit

settling: L-BFGS-B from u = 0 with declared options, then Newton polish (<= 20 steps, backtracking 1/2 up to 30 halvings; accept if E lowers, or E rises <= 1e-12 max(1,|E|) with max|grad| strictly lower) toward max|grad| < 1e-12; certified iff max|grad| < 1e-8 and min Hessian eigenvalue > 1e-8

drives: h = cos(n theta + pi c / 2) + nuisance; F-low n = 1, F-high n = 8; nuisance = orthonormal real Fourier basis (DC, cos/sin 1..15, Nyquist) with N(0,1) coefficients from default_rng(20261024), shape (2,4,50,32), rescaled per draw to RMS alpha/sqrt(2)
halves: draws 0-24 train, 25-49 test; readout noise sigma0 * eps, eps from default_rng([20261025, L, l, family])

measures: S population variance over all certified drives; P within-class variance averaged over classes; nearest-class-mean decoding (strict: unsettled test drives wrong, out of 100); Mahalanobis on training half with pooled covariance (dof N_train - 4) + sigma0^2 I
profile at sigma0 = 0.1 in each family: T1 S(1) >= S(l) all l; T2 P(L)/P(1) <= 0.25; T3 strict D(L) >= 0.9; eligible only if all 400 canonical settlings certified
multistability: 8 probes (draw 0 of each class and family), 16 starts N(0,1) from default_rng([20261026, L, s]), greedy merge of certified states at RMS < 1e-6
superposition: pairs i = 0..7, h1 = F-low class i mod 4 draw 25+i, h2 = F-high class (i+1) mod 4 draw 25+i; defect null if denominator < 1e-12 or any state unsettled
candidate depth: double well beta = 1, gamma = 1, alpha = 1, smallest L meeting the profile
reported floats rounded to 10 significant digits
BLAS pinned to one thread (OPENBLAS/OMP/MKL_NUM_THREADS=1) before numpy import
